note: Citation registry. Rules in knowledge/rules/ reference these keys. The texts themselves are NOT redistributed in this repository; the wording of every AstroBot rule is original. `repoPath` points into the third-party reference collection listed under `collections` for anyone who wants to check a doctrine against its source.

collections.name: ASTROLOGY-BOOKS-DATABASE
collections.caution: The collection's own README states its files were gathered from freely available sources and disclaims responsibility for copyright. Treat every file in it as third-party copyrighted material: consult it, do not copy from it.

bphs.title: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra
bphs.author: attributed to Parashara
bphs.note: The base text for house, sign and planet doctrine used throughout AstroBot.

phaladeepika.title: Phaladeepika
phaladeepika.author: Mantreswara
phaladeepika.note: Concise and unusually systematic on planets in houses and on yogas.

saravali.title: Saravali
saravali.author: Kalyana Varma
saravali.note: Detailed on planets in signs and in houses.

jaimini.title: Jaimini Sutras
jaimini.author: Jaimini
jaimini.note: A separate system (rashi drishti, chara karakas). Do not mix its rules with Parashari rules without marking them.

prasna-marga.title: Prasna Marga
prasna-marga.author: unknown (Kerala tradition)
prasna-marga.note: Horary. Relevant to question-charts, not to natal interpretation.

strijataka.title: Strijataka
strijataka.author: unknown
strijataka.note: Historical interest. Its gendered judgements are period-bound and are not encoded as rules.

lal-kitab.title: Lal Kitab
lal-kitab.author: Pandit Roop Chand Joshi
lal-kitab.note: A distinct tradition with its own house-grid logic and remedies. Frequently contradicts Parashari rules; always tag rules from it so the engine can keep them apart.

deva-keralam.title: Deva Keralam (Chandra Kala Nadi)
deva-keralam.author: unknown
deva-keralam.note: Nadi style; highly specific combinations rather than general principles.

community.title: Community and social-media submissions
community.author: various
community.note: Knowledge added through the app. Never promoted above `secondary` without a classical citation being attached by review.

parashari-modern.title: Modern Parashari reading
parashari-modern.author: various commentators
parashari-modern.note: A sibling of antardasha-tradition and unverified for the same reason. These are readings in common modern circulation that no classical text in the reference collection was found to state. A rule lands here when it was found citing a text that does not support it: the statement may still be sound, but the citation was the thing that was wrong, and removing the false citation matters more than keeping the authority. Re-cite to a named text and locus if one is ever found.

antardasha-tradition.title: Common Parashari antardasha doctrine
antardasha-tradition.author: various commentators
antardasha-tradition.note: Deliberately unverified, and weighted accordingly. These are the sub-period results as the Parashari commentarial tradition commonly states them, reasoned from the natural friendship between the two lords and from what each signifies. No single text has been read line by line to place them, so citing bphs or any other named work here would assert a check that has not been made. Any rule on this key should be re-cited to a named text and locus once someone has verified it, which raises its weight from 0.35 to that text's authority.
verifyAgainst: Classics books/Book. Encyclopedia of vedic astro - dasha systems.pdf

astrobot.title: AstroBot derived
astrobot.author: AstroBot engine
astrobot.note: Statements the engine composes from reference data (lordship, dignity, aspect geometry) rather than from a cited rule.
